name: Heavenly Principles
desc: The First Descender, who defeated seven Dragon Sovereigns of the world and created people. The Primordial One may be Phanes.

customize.name: Descenders
customize.desc: Beings from outside of Teyvat, whose wills can rival an entire world.

customize.text: The Primordial One is one of the entities from another world, whose wills can rival an entire world.

customize.name: Shades
customize.desc: Four Shades created by the Primordial One.

customize.text: The Primordial One created four shining shades and reshaped Teyvat along with them.

customize.name: Elemental Dragons
customize.desc: An ancient race, who ruled Teyvat long before human existence. Dragons belong to the Light Realm.

customize.text: Before the appearance of the Primordial One, the world was ruled by elemental dragons. After a forty-year war, the dragons were defeated and the seven nations submitted to the First Throne. The Primordial One stole the dragon's authority and later used it for the divine thrones.

customize.name: Nibelung
customize.desc: The leader of the elemental dragons and the primeval creator of Teyvat.

customize.text: The original creator of Teyvat, who left the planet to explore other worlds. While he was wandering, the First Descender captured Teyvat. When Nibelung returned with forbidden knowledge, the

customize.name: War of Funerary Flame
customize.desc: The war between the Dragon Lord Nibelung and the Heavenly Principles that took place 6,000 years ago.

customize.text: broke out between them, during which Nibelung died.

customize.name: Moon Goddesses
customize.desc: Aria, Sonnet, and Canon — three sisters and Moon Goddesses who once ruled the firmament. Columbina Hyposelenia is a Moon Goddess who was born thousands of years after the Three Moon's death.

customize.text: When the Heavenly Principles appeared in Teyvat, they made a peace treaty with the Moon Goddesses. During the War of the Funerary Flame, when Nibelung turned the Moons into weapons, the Heavenly Principles shattered two Moons and sent the third one beyond the sky. From that moment on, the Goddesses ceased to belong to Teyvat and ultimately perished due to rejection.

customize.name: Angels
customize.desc: Also known as Heavenly envoys, their primary duties were to help people. They were later expelled from Celestia and consequently lost their bodies and minds.

customize.text:
The Heavenly Principles created angels from light itself. The silver wings of the angels shimmered like moonlit flames, their heads were adorned with crowns of sevenfold radiance, and their names were the love promised to all creatures by the heavenly god, or the power over all the peoples of the earth. The angels were the most faithful servants in the heavenly court and envoys to the people who prospered under their protection.
First Angel
The First Angel met a Voyager from a distant world who revealed the truth about the world to her, and she fell in love with her. Together, they planned to go against the laws of Heavenly Principles, but they cursed the angels and deprived them of their names and minds.

Civilizations destroyed by the Heavenly Principles.
One Who Came After
Severely wounded in the great war of vengeance, the Primordial One had their functions ruined and could no longer use their absolute authority to suppress the original order of this world. To continue to subdue and control the resentments and loathing of the world, the First Throne and one who came after created the

customize.name: Gnosis
customize.desc: Gnoses are internal magical foci that each of The Seven possesses, allowing them to resonate directly with Celestia itself and serving as an emblem of their status. The Gnoses were created from the remains of the Third Descender.

customize.name: Azurelight
customize.desc: This blade was once pure and pristine as a white dawn star, but it has since been tinted a deep, dark blue.
